source: Editorial task: update volunteers on orchard pruning plans. Trustees deferred pruning until February after the arborist requested a bird survey. A grant application is being prepared separately. No reason linking the deferral to the grant is stated.

idea.title: Pruning waits for the requested bird survey
idea.rationale: The arborist requested a survey before pruning.
idea.evidence: Trustees deferred pruning until February after the survey request.
